summary_en: Playful, high-performance marketing site for mobile game — character-driven design with smooth animations.
summary_pt: Site de marketing divertido e de alta performance para jogo mobile — design focado em personagens com animações suaves.
challenge_en: Appeal to casual mobile gamers while showcasing game features and driving app store conversions.
challenge_pt: Atrair jogadores mobile casuais enquanto mostra funcionalidades do jogo e impulsiona conversões na app store.
approach_en: Character-forward design with playful interactions; clear feature breakdown; app store CTAs above fold; optimized for mobile devices.
approach_pt: Design focado em personagens com interações divertidas; breakdown claro de funcionalidades; CTAs da app store acima da dobra; otimizado para dispositivos mobile.
outcome_en: Engaging marketing site that increased app store traffic by 200% and improved conversion rates.
outcome_pt: Site de marketing envolvente que aumentou tráfego da app store em 200% e melhorou taxas de conversão.
body_en:
## Character Showcase

Large hero featuring the SumoQubes characters with subtle animations and parallax effects. Each character has a dedicated section highlighting their unique abilities.

## Feature Highlights

Clear, digestible sections explaining game mechanics, social features, and progression systems. Supported by gameplay GIFs and screenshots.

## Download Flow

Strategically placed app store buttons with smart detection for iOS/Android. Clear messaging about game features and social proof (ratings, downloads).
